content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Sumter

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years of experience. Review PMI's education and experience guidelines to confirm you meet the credential's prerequisites before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions on your schedule, covering all five process groups and knowledge areas PMI tests. You'll earn the required contact hours needed to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education, experience, and training hours. Pay the PMI exam fee and wait for approval. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep materials, practice tests, and instructor support to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam with Pearson VUE at a testing center convenient to you. Pass the four-hour, 180-question exam to earn your PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) throughout each three-year renewal cycle by taking courses, volunteering, or mentoring others in project management. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your PMP active and demonstrate ongoing expertise to employers in your local market.
